news.text: Welcome to 2006. Ownership expects 33 wins. Salary cap: $78.8M.
Free agency is open. Fill out your roster, set the rotation, and start a new season.
Seattle selects Stefan Wallace (PG) with pick 34.
Seattle selects Lamar Pierce (C) with pick 4.
Houston wins the draft lottery. The 2005 draft is underway.
Nico Santos signs a 2-year, $11.8M contract with Seattle.
Chicago Union are the 2005 champions. Kendrick Wright takes home Most Valuable Player.
The postseason is here. Sixteen teams. One championship.
Solomon Diallo will miss 2 games with a sore knee.
Kendrick Wright will miss 18 games with a sore knee.
The trade deadline has passed. Rosters are locked for the stretch run.
Kendrick Marshall will miss 9 games with a hamstring strain.
Kendrick Wright will miss 14 games with a wrist sprain.
Boston acquires Trey Miles from Milwaukee for Marcus Price and a 2006 first-round pick.
Drew Rivers will miss 4 games with a wrist sprain.
Blake Coleman will miss 2 games with a hamstring strain.
Chicago acquires Kendrick Coleman from Sacramento for Solomon Wright and a 2006 first-round pick.
Drew Rivers will miss 9 games with a wrist sprain.
Nico Santos will miss 15 games with a wrist sprain.
Solomon Santos is hired as head coach.
Kevin takes control of the Seattle Evergreens. Ownership expects 35 wins.
